jobs.occupation: Sr. Accountant position w/ strategic impact - Zaventem - Legal
jobs.description:
Our client is an international firm that provides legal services across different sectors. They are currently looking for a senior accountant that can work autonomously to support the finance manager.

Jobomschrijving

In this role you will be handling the A-Z accounting tasks, including the following:

• General accounting tasks
• Performing monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings
• Review and control of the balance sheet
• Preparation and filing of the annual accounts (NBB)
• Submission of periodic VAT returns
• Preparation of corporate income tax
• Point of contact for audit matters
• Monthly financial reporting
• Process optimization and automation

We are looking for someone that matches the following criteria:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting
• Minimum of 5 years experience in general accounting
• Strong knowledge of BE GAAP
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French, good command in English
• Excellent command of Excel
• Analytical mindset
• Team player with good communication skills

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer.

• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities.

• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
